scheme_name: Motivation of Unemployed Persons to Start Self-employed Enterprises
other_conditions: The applicant's age should align with the existing norms of banks
The applicant should be able to read and write fluently
The applicant should be a permanent resident of the area for at least 3 years
All economically viable service and industrial activities are eligible
benefits_summary: Loans ranging ₹10,000‑₹2,00,000 with subsidies of 50% (up to ₹10,000) or 25% (up to ₹25,000) and repayment at prevailing bank interest rates
